# `aitbc agent-wallet balance`

Show simulated wallet balance (not coordinator spend sessions — see agent-identity API).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent-wallet balance [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-id` | text | — | yes | Agent ID. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent-wallet balance --agent-id <agent_id>
```
